关键词: Redemption of its Remaining 8.95% Notes Due June 2, 2014
主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. announced the redemption of its remaining 8.95% Notes due June 2, 2014. This announcement was made as part of a Form 6-K filing with the SEC on February 4, 2013. The filing indicates that the company is complying with its obligations under the notes, which were issued as part of its capital structure. The redemption of these notes is a significant financial event for the company, as it involves the repayment of a substantial amount of debt. The filing also includes the incorporation by reference of the Form 6-K and the exhibit thereto into the company's registration statement on Form F-9. The filing was signed by B.D. Lawson, who is the Managing Partner and CFO of Brookfield Asset Management Inc. This event reflects the company's financial strategy and its commitment to managing its debt obligations.
